{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple records: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Maximum sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max()}")

# Show first few rows of duplicate patients
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)]
duplicate_patients.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq']).head(10)"}
